title: Beef Stew Venezolano
description: A hearty, comforting beef stew inspired by the flavors of Venezuela. This rich and flavorful dish is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown beef in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per batch.
Remove browned beef from pot; set aside.
Reduce heat to medium; add onion to pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, tomato paste, cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to pot; cook for 1 minute.
Add red wine, chicken broth, and browned beef to pot; bring to a boil.
Return browned beef to pot; cover and transfer to oven.
Bake at 300  for 2 1/2 hours or until beef is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
